_comment: atelier mutation testing config. See skills/atelier/references/workflow.md (Mutation testing).
_packageManager_comment: Stryker doesn't fully understand Bun yet; tell it npm so it doesn't probe for yarn/pnpm lockfiles.
_commandRunner_comment: The tests under src/ only. The lint-gate fixtures at the root lint through ESLint, which takes seconds to load on every run and exercises the config, never a line of src/, so it can kill no mutant.
_mutate_comment: Core only: src/domain + src/use-cases. Test files have no logic to mutate; ports/ files are type-only (zero mutable code).
_incremental_comment: No incremental mode. Stryker writes that file by pretty-printing the whole report through JSON.stringify, and on a full sweep of 4,413 mutants the string is long enough to throw RangeError: Invalid string length under Node, in reportAll, after every mutant has already run. It bought nothing anyway: mutate-changed.sh and mutate-staged.sh delete the file before every run, and CI discards it with the checkout.
_reporters_comment: json writes reports/mutation/mutation.json, which scripts/check-mutation-files.ts reads after mutate:changed and mutate:staged to hold every file to the break, not only their total. The full sweep on main passes its own --reporters and skips both.
_ignorePatterns_comment: Skip non-source dirs from the sandbox copy. .claude/ may contain a symlink Stryker cannot copy (ENOTSUP); the rest are pure noise.
